You: The things you did… {{wi}}I don’t know what I would do if I were in a similar position to you. 
#Cashier.Face.depressed
You: I’m not saying that your actions were justified. Your abuser died, but along with him an innocent woman. That’s something you will have to live with for the rest of your existence, but I won’t judge you.
You: When someone is backed into a corner, they are capable of doing horrible things in their desperation. I think that’s exactly what happened to you.
You: I think that you are deeply hurt and it wouldn’t sit well with me just to abandon you. I was the one that reached out to you and ignored your wishes to be left alone. The least I can do is to take responsibility for that.
Melissa: Why are you doing this…{{wi}} You are not normal…
Melissa: Do you really think that someone like me, a murderer, has a right to laugh with all of you?
You: None of us had to deal with abuse like you did.
You: You lived through hell for weeks and only took action when you had no other choice. It’s unfortunate that this woman died, but my understanding is that it wasn’t your intention, right?
Melissa: I cannot be forgiven…
You: Maybe so, but no one can blame you for wanting to live.
You: Take your time and think about it. I won’t push you any further. You will decide what you want.
Melissa: …
You: Goodbye, Melissa. {{wI}}See you later. {{Wi}}I hope.
